title: fumaria dubia
intro: Fumaria dubia, commonly known as Poor Man's Treacle or Yellow Fumitory, is a flowering plant belonging to the Fumaria genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in digestion. The health benefits of Fumaria dubia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as fumarine, and other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
